aboutPage.heroTitle: A Legacy of Faith, Devotion & Divine Grace
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: For generations, Sankashta Mata Mandir has been a beacon of hope, a home of peace, and a sacred space where countless devotees have found solace in the divine presence of Maa Sankashta.
aboutPage.storyP1: Sankashta Mata Mandir was established with a divine vision — to create a sacred sanctuary where every devotee could seek the blessings of Maa Sankashta, the remover of obstacles. What began as a humble shrine has, through decades of unwavering faith and community support, grown into a revered spiritual destination.
aboutPage.storyP2: The temple stands as a living testament to the power of devotion. Every day, hundreds of devotees visit to offer prayers, participate in aarti, and experience the profound peace that permeates this sacred space. The temple's traditions have been lovingly preserved and passed down through generations of priests and trustees.
aboutPage.storyP3: Today, Sankashta Mata Mandir continues to serve as a spiritual anchor for the community — hosting festivals, conducting poojas, distributing prasadam, and extending seva (selfless service) to all who come with faith in their hearts.
aboutPage.missionText: To preserve and propagate the sacred traditions of Maa Sankashta, serve all devotees with love and humility, and create a spiritual sanctuary where faith, peace, and community flourish.
aboutPage.visionText: To be a timeless beacon of devotion, where every soul who enters finds peace, every prayer is heard, and every heart is touched by the divine grace of Maa Sankashta.
aboutPage.value1Text: Unwavering devotion to Maa Sankashta and the timeless traditions of our temple.
aboutPage.value2Text: Selfless service to all devotees, without distinction, always with love and humility.
aboutPage.value3Text: Bringing people together in devotion, celebration, and shared spiritual growth.
aboutPage.value4Text: Maintaining the sanctity of our temple and the sincerity of every ritual.
aboutPage.timelineSubtitle: Milestones that shaped our temple's sacred history
aboutPage.timeline1Text: A small shrine was consecrated by devoted villagers, marking the humble beginning of Sankashta Mata Mandir.
aboutPage.timeline2Text: With growing devotee numbers, the temple was expanded with a larger sanctum and community hall.
aboutPage.timeline3Text: Daily free prasadam and annadan seva was initiated, serving hundreds of devotees every day.
aboutPage.timeline4Text: A grand festival marked 40 years of devotion, drawing thousands of devotees from across the region.
aboutPage.timeline5Text: The temple launched its digital presence, bringing darshan and seva to devotees worldwide.

contactPage.faqSubtitle: Quick answers to help you plan your visit and participate in our sevas.
contactPage.faq1A: The temple is open daily from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Morning aarti is at 6:30 AM and evening aarti is at 7:00 PM.
contactPage.faq2Q: How can I book a pooja?
contactPage.faq2A: You can book a pooja by calling us, visiting the temple office, or filling out the contact form above. Our team will confirm your booking within 24 hours.
contactPage.faq3A: Yes, free parking is available for devotees near the temple entrance. Additional parking is available on festival days.
contactPage.faq4A: Yes, we accept online donations through our secure payment gateway. Visit the Donate page or contact us for more details.
contactPage.faq5A: Yes, free prasadam is distributed to all devotees daily after morning and evening aarti. Special prasadam is available during festivals.
contactPage.faq6Q: Can I volunteer at the temple?
contactPage.faq6A: Absolutely! We welcome volunteers for various sevas. Please contact us through the form above mentioning 'Volunteer' as your subject.
contactPage.ctaText: Our temple team is always ready to assist you with any questions or guidance you may need.

donatePage.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about donating to our temple.
donatePage.faq1A: Yes, all donations to Sankashta Mata Mandir Trust are eligible for tax exemption under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act. You will receive a receipt by email.
donatePage.faq2A: Donations support temple maintenance, daily poojas, annadan seva, festival celebrations, priest support, and community service. We maintain full transparency in our accounts.
donatePage.faq3A: Yes, simply check the 'Donate anonymously' box in the form. Your name will not be displayed anywhere.
donatePage.faq4Q: Can I donate from outside India?
donatePage.faq4A: Yes, we accept international donations. Please contact us at info@sankashtamatamandir.org for bank details and other options.
donatePage.faq5Q: Do I get a receipt for my donation?
donatePage.faq5A: Yes, you will receive an official receipt by email within 24 hours of your donation. Keep it safe for tax purposes.
donatePage.faq6Q: Can I donate in honor of someone?
donatePage.faq6A: Absolutely! Mention the name in your donation message, and we will conduct a special pooja in their honor at the temple.
donatePage.ctaText: Your donation is not just money — it's a blessing that reaches hundreds of devotees. May Maa Sankashta always bless you.

privacyPage.heroSubtitle: Your privacy is sacred to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacyPage.section1Text: Sankashta Mata Mandir Trust ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacyPage.section2Text: We may collect the following types of information when you interact with our website:
privacyPage.section2List1: Personal information: name, email address, phone number, and address
privacyPage.section2List2: Donation information: amount, purpose, and payment details
privacyPage.section2List3: Booking information: pooja/event details and preferred dates
privacyPage.section2List4: Technical information: IP address, browser type, device info
privacyPage.section3Text: The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
privacyPage.section3List1: To process donations and issue tax exemption receipts
privacyPage.section3List2: To confirm and manage pooja/event bookings
privacyPage.section3List3: To send updates about festivals, events, and temple activities
privacyPage.section3List4: To improve our website and services based on usage patterns
privacyPage.section3List5: To comply with legal and regulatory requirements
privacyPage.section4Text: We take data security seriously. Your personal information is protected through:
privacyPage.section4List1: SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmissions
privacyPage.section4List3: Restricted access to personal data within our team
privacyPage.section4List4: Regular security audits and system updates
privacyPage.section5Text: We do NOT sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your data only in the following limited circumstances:
privacyPage.section5List1: With trusted payment processors to complete transactions
privacyPage.section5List2: With email/SMS service providers to send you updates
privacyPage.section5List3: When required by law, court order, or government authority
privacyPage.section5List4: With your explicit consent for specific purposes
privacyPage.section6Text: Our website uses cookies to enhance your experience, remember your preferences (such as language), and analyze website traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect site functionality.
privacyPage.section7Text: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacyPage.section7List1: Right to access: request a copy of your data we hold
privacyPage.section7List2: Right to correction: update inaccurate or incomplete data
privacyPage.section7List3: Right to deletion: request removal of your personal data
privacyPage.section7List4: Right to opt-out: unsubscribe from communications at any time
privacyPage.section7List5: Right to complain: contact us or the relevant authority
privacyPage.section8Text: Our website is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have collected data from a child, please contact us immediately for removal.
privacyPage.section9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated 'Last Updated' date. We encourage you to review this policy regularly.
privacyPage.section10Text: If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:
privacyPage.ctaText: If you have concerns about how your data is handled, our team is here to answer your questions.
